This repository does not accept pull requests from outside contributors while it is published
from a private development repository. Guardian is built there and published here as a short
series of curated commits for each release, so a pull request here cannot be merged as it stands.

To report a bug, a wrong verdict or a gap in the documents, or to ask a question, open an issue
instead, as
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/thomascburns/ssc-guardian/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
describes.
